findings.proposition: Larger patterns are composed of smaller motive and corrective forms, and the form remains constant across degree.
The reverse process of subdivision apparently continues indefinitely; all waves both have and are component waves; the degree-label progression is infinite in both directions.
Smaller waves may be revealed by transaction data, and unclear higher-timeframe structure calls for examination of shorter-term movements.
Straight-line advance and decline are called simplest expressions in a Fibonacci abstraction, followed by higher complexity and a sequence extending to infinity.

completion_requirement: No primitive-local completion rule is supplied.
negative_cases: Finest visible swing is not sufficient.
Smallest available timeframe is not sufficient.
Maximum practical resolution is not sufficient.
Three or five visible moves are not sufficient without recursive family proof.
Caller-declared family or completion is not sufficient.
